turns.speaker: system

turns.speaker: agent

turns.speaker: customer

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If everything goes smoothly, you should see a refund reflected on your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days after we process the return. However, that timeline can vary depending on your bank or card issuer.

turns.speaker: agent

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Details of 0472 2nd Ave, San Mateo, CA 189 have been entered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How would you like to complete your return? Your can opt for By Mail, In Store, or your nearest UPS Drop Off Center.

turns.speaker: customer

turns.speaker: system

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're all set! The return label and details for how to complete your return will be sent to you by email. Is there anything more I may help you with today?

turns.speaker: agent
